vuln_statements.stmt_text:
for (i = 0; i < sp->xlen; i++)
		if (sp->xvec[i].pol == info->pol)
vuln_statements.explanation: This loop iterates through sp->xvec using sp->xlen as the bound without validating against info->pol size. When sp->xlen exceeds the actual number of valid entries or when accessing info->pol without bounds checking, this allows out-of-bounds array access during policy matching in the match_policy_in function.
